run_negative_http2_test: run a negative HTTP/2 test case like goaway or rst_after_header against a gRPC server
test_goaway_handling: test how the gRPC client handles GOAWAY frames sent by the server mid-stream
test_rst_stream_scenarios: test RST_STREAM error handling after headers, during data, or after data transmission
test_max_streams_limit: test the MAX_STREAMS flow control limit by sending 15 concurrent requests to the server
validate_grpc_status_codes: validate gRPC status codes and details for expected negative HTTP/2 conditions
